title: Enquiry From Hbm Consulate General Re Cheng Chin Tu, Li Keng Lin, & Chan Chow Seng Communist Suspects

page_data.en:
Form No. 2
G. 2,000-1-32

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

（印：File No. D 3564 / SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE / C & S. L. REGISTRY / Section 2, Station / No. D 3564 / Date May 16, 1932 / D.I. 76 / 5 / 32）

Subject (in full)...... Inquiry from H.B.M. Consulate-General re certain communist
suspects.

Made by... D. I. Kuh Pao-hwa .................... Forwarded by... S. B. Km. S. I.

With reference to the letter of April 22, 1932 from
H. B. M. Consulate-General on the subject of the undermentioned
addresses which were found during the course of a Police raid
on the offices of the Perak Communist Committee, the following
is the result of our enquiries :-

1) Cheng Chin Tu (郑振铎)
Editorial Department of the monthly novel (小说月报编辑部),
The Commercial Press Ltd.,
538 Paoshan Road, Chapei, Shanghai.

In consequence of the recent Sino-Japanese hostilities,
the Editorial Department of the Commercial Press Ltd removed
from Chapei and is at present located at No.78 Szechuen Road.
Cheng Chin Tu (郑振铎), age about 35, speaking the Shanghai
dialect, was formerly in the employ of the Commercial Press as
the editor of a monthly magazine known as the "Siao Seu Yeu Pao"
(小说月报). This post he held for about ten years, when he
resigned early in Autumn 1931 to take up an appointment as a
professor of the Yieh Ching (燕京) University at Peiping.
According to our information, Cheng, during his employ with
the Commercial Press, was engaged in editing and translating
articles on Socialism but was not known to be connected with
the Chinese Communist Party.

2) Li Keng Lin (李公麟)
c/o Iong Iong Pang (杨仰攀)
Chhun Chiong Middle School (泉漳中学)
Yut Tai Bridge, Liong Hoa Road (就事路口洋桥),
Shanghai.

Li Keng Lin, age about 26, native of Canton, was a
student at the above school for four years and returned to

报告

（印：档案号 D 3564 / 上海公共租界工部局警务处 / C & S. L. 登记处 / 第2分区，巡捕房 / 编号 D 3564 / 日期 1932年5月16日 / D.I. 76 / 5 / 32）

事由（全称）...... 英国驻沪总领事馆就某些共产主义嫌疑人的查询。

制作人... 督察 顾宝华 (Kuh Pao-hwa) .................... 转呈人... 特别巡捕 Km. S. I.

兹就英国驻沪总领事馆1932年4月22日来信，提及在警方突袭霹雳共产党委员会（Perak Communist Committee）办公室过程中发现的下列地址一事，现将我方调查结果汇报如下：-

1) 郑振铎 (Cheng Chin Tu)
《小说月报》编辑部，
商务印书馆有限公司，
上海闸北宝山路538号。

鉴于近期中日战事，商务印书馆有限公司编辑部已从闸北迁出，目前位于四川路78号。郑振铎，年龄约35岁，讲上海话，此前受雇于商务印书馆，担任名为《小说月报》的月刊编辑。他担任此职约十年，于1931年初秋辞职，赴北平燕京大学任教授。据我方掌握的信息，郑在商务印书馆任职期间，从事社会主义相关文章的编辑和翻译工作，但并未发现其与中国共产党有牵连。

2) 李公麟 (Li Keng Lin)
由 杨仰攀 (Iong Iong Pang) 转交
泉漳中学
龙华路日晖桥 (Yut Tai Bridge, Liong Hoa Road)，
上海。

李公麟，年龄约26岁，广东人，曾在上述学校就读四年，并于

3) Chan Chow Seng (陳秋聲)

Furthermore, inquiries regarding these suspects, of whom nothing is

Lu L Tao-hwa

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTRY
No. D 3564
BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL,
P.O/BOX 260. / SHANGHAI.
26. 4. 32
April 22nd 1932.

Dear Givens,

H.N.S. has asked me to send you the following
addresses which were obtained as the result of a
Police raid on the offices of the Perak local
Communist Committee. Will you please let me know
the result of your enquiries.

1. Cheng Chin Tu (鄭振鐸).
Editorial Dept. of the monthly novel,
(小說月報編輯部)
The Commercial Press Ltd.,
538 Paoshan Rd., Chapek, Shanghai.

2. Li Keng Lin (李公麟),
C/o Iong Iong Pang (楊仰攀),
Chhun Chiong Middle School,
(泉漳中學)
Yut Tai Bridge, Llong Hoa Road.
(龍華路日暉橋)
Shanghai.

3. Chan Chow Seng (陳秋聲)
Kung Po Lan (貢寶瀾)
C/o Kung Peng Koan (貢水君)
9, Kung Lake Road, Shanghai.

Yours sincerely,
[Signature]

T.P.Givens, Esq.,
Special Branch,
S.M.P.

(批：No records in
Reg. S.B. Registry
under these names.
26.4.32 W.G.)

(批：S2, For attention please. This matter is
all pressing.
D.J. Kul 27/4/32. M. 26:4:32.)

亲爱的吉文斯 (Givens)：

H.N.S. 让我将以下地址发送给你，这些地址是警方突袭霹雳地方共产党委员会办公室后获得的。请告知我你方调查的结果。

1. 郑振铎 (Cheng Chin Tu)。
《小说月报》编辑部，
商务印书馆有限公司，
上海闸北宝山路538号。

2. 李公麟 (Li Keng Lin)，
由 杨仰攀 (Iong Iong Pang) 转交，
泉漳中学，
上海龙华路日晖桥。

3. 陈秋声 (Chan Chow Seng)
贡宝澜 (Kung Po Lan)
由 贡水君 (Kung Peng Koan) 转交
上海公湖路9号。

此致，
[签名]

T.P. 吉文斯 (Givens) 先生，
特别部门，
上海公共租界工部局警务处。

（批注：特别部门登记处无上述姓名的记录。1932年4月26日 W.G.）

（批注：S2，请予关注。此事十分紧急。D.J. Kul 1932年4月27日。M. 1932年4月26日。）
